description:
[Deterministic AML UBO ownership cascade & PEP audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates multi-tier corporate shareholding chains to identify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO) exceeding statutory 25% ownership or control thresholds under 5AMLD/6AMLD (Directive (EU) 2018/843) and D.Lgs. 231/2007, flagging Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and opaque jurisdictions.
Usage: Use this tool for statutory AML/KYC onboarding, corporate governance audits, and sanction ownership screening.
Returns: JSON object with { targetCompanyName: string, beneficialOwners: array, controlBySeniorManagementRequired: boolean, amlRiskScore: number, amlRiskLevel: string, redFlags: array, complianceNotes: string }.

companyVatOrId.description: Tax code, VAT number, or national registration ID

fallbackToLegalRepresentative.description: Whether to fallback to senior executive management if no UBO exceeds 25%

legalRepresentativeName.description: Name of administrator or legal representative

shareholders.description: Shareholding structure nodes for direct and indirect cascading ownership calculation

intermediateSharePercentage.description: Share percentage held in intermediate entity (0 to 100)

isNaturalPerson.description: True if physical person, false if holding company or trust

isPep.description: Whether person holds prominent public functions (Politically Exposed Person)

name: ultimate_beneficial_owner_audit
